# From CIB to 5-Star Kitchens: Inspiring Success Stories of Our Alumni

(To be translated into Bengali)

The true measure of an institution is not the number of students it enrolls, but the number of lives it transforms. In 2026, [The Culinary Institute of Bangladesh (CIB)](/en/about) celebrates a milestone—our alumni are now leading kitchens in some of the most prestigious 5-star hotels across the globe. These **CIB student success stories** are a testament to the power of high-skill training and industrial discipline.

## 1. Crossing Borders: The Journey of Arif Rahman

Arif joined CIB three years ago with a dream of working in Europe. Having no prior professional experience, he enrolled in our 'Professional Chef Course - Basic to Advance.' Under the mentorship of **Dewan Ismail**, Arif mastered the fundamentals of French and Mediterranean cuisines along with strict **ISO-HACCP** protocols.

Today, Arif is a Chef de Partie at a luxury resort in Italy. 'CIB didn't just teach me how to cook; they taught me how to survive and thrive in a world-class kitchen,' Arif shares. His story is a blueprint for [how to get a chef job abroad](/en/blog/chef-jobs-abroad-for-bangladeshi-students).

## 2. Breaking the Glass Ceiling: Sumaiya Akter's Rise

Sumaiya joined CIB to pursue her passion for pastry. In a traditionally male-dominated industry, she stood out for her technical precision and artistic flair. Trained by **Rafeya Chowdhury**, Sumaiya mastered the complex arts of lamination and artisan bread in our [baking course in Dhaka](/en/blog/professional-baking-course-dhaka-opportunities).

She is now the Head Pastry Chef at a leading 5-star hotel in Dhaka, commanding a [high executive salary](/en/blog/executive-chef-salary-bangladesh-guide). Sumaiya's success proves that with the right mentorship and industrial-grade facilities, there are no limits to what our students can achieve.

## 3. From Employee to Employer: The Cloud Kitchen Success of Tanvir Ahmed

Tanvir was a career shifter who wanted to launch his own food brand. He used his time at CIB to not only master cooking but also the business side of the industry. He paid close attention to the modules on [food business licensing](/en/blog/food-business-license-bangladesh-process) and [restaurant food costing](/en/blog/restaurant-food-costing-formula-profitability).

Tanvir now owns one of the most successful [cloud kitchens in Dhaka](/en/blog/start-cloud-kitchen-bangladesh-low-investment), serving gourmet Turkish cuisine. 'CIB gave me the confidence to move from being a cook to being a food entrepreneur,' says Tanvir.

## 4. The 'CIB Edge': Why Our Alumni Succeed

What makes **CIB student success stories** so consistent? It is the combination of elite facilities and world-class mentorship. Our 2,000 sq. ft. [commercial lab](/en/about) ensures that our students are never intimidated by the scale of a 5-star kitchen. 

Our curriculum, mapped to **UK and NSDA standards**, ensures that their skills are recognized globally from day one. This institutional prestige is why executive chefs at Radisson Blu, InterContinental, and Pan Pacific Sonargaon actively seek out CIB graduates for their teams.

## 5. Join the Next Generation of Success Stories

Your culinary journey is just one decision away. Whether you want to work in a local 5-star hotel, move abroad, or start your own food business, CIB provides the roadmap and the skills to get you there. Our [Admission Portal](/en/admission) is currently open for the next batch of future culinary leaders.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How soon can I find a job after graduating from CIB?
Many of our top-performing students receive conditional job offers even before completing their 3-month internship. Our industry links with 5-star hotels ensure a very high placement rate for dedicated students.

### Can I achieve success at CIB if I have no prior cooking experience?
Absolutely. Most of our most successful alumni, like Arif Rahman, started with zero professional experience. Our curriculum is designed to build your skills from the ground up, focusing on technical mastery and industrial discipline.

### Do the mentors at CIB provide career counseling?
Yes. Mentors like **Dewan Ismail** and **Rafeya Chowdhury** take a personal interest in our students' career paths. They provide guidance on portfolio building, trade test preparation, and global job search strategies.

### What certifications will I receive upon completion?
You will receive a CIB professional certificate, and you have the option to apply for **NSDA & ISO-HACCP certifications** and **NSDA-approved** credentials, which are recognized by employers worldwide.

### How can I apply to become a student at CIB?
The first step is to visit our [Admission page](/en/admission) and fill out the inquiry form. You can also visit our campus in Dhanmondi to see our [commercial kitchen facilities](/en/gallery) and meet the mentors in person.
